zh: 修正智能退休結果把年齡顯示成「65 年／100 年」的單位錯誤；目前年齡、退休年齡與預期壽命統一顯示為「歲」，自然語言輸入的「活到100歲」仍會真正帶入退休模型。
優化智能資產組合分享海報的版面比例。「具體怎麼買」保留現金／應急金、長期儲蓄保險、債券與寬基指數的完整操作說明，同時避免壓縮「目標」與「建議資產組合」到難以閱讀。
強化 Web 自動冒煙工具：不再把測試網址寫死為 8099、可在路由恢復舊捲動位置時正確檢查最高優先的智能資產組合入口，並改為依實際題數走完智能保險問卷。
重新完成 390×844 手機尺寸的真實 Web 流程驗證：智能向導、退休儲蓄保險、65歲退休／活到100歲／可虧30%／傳承／長期鎖定的智能資產組合，均能完成結果與分享海報；完整 Flutter 測試全部通過。
en: Fixed age units in smart retirement results where retirement age and life expectancy could be shown as “65 years / 100 years”. Current age, retirement age and life expectancy now use age units while “live to 100” continues to feed the retirement model correctly.

Rebalanced the Smart Portfolio share-poster layout. Detailed buying actions for emergency cash, long-term savings insurance, bonds and broad index assets remain readable without shrinking the Goal and Portfolio sections too aggressively.

Hardened the real-Web QA harness: the test URL is no longer hard-coded to port 8099, priority-card checks tolerate restored scroll position, and the retirement-insurance flow now walks the actual question count instead of assuming a fixed number.

Re-ran the 390×844 end-to-end Web flows for Smart Wizard, Retirement × Savings Insurance, and Smart Portfolio with retire-at-65/live-to-100/30%-loss-tolerance/legacy/long-lock inputs. Result and poster generation complete successfully and the full Flutter test suite passes.
